text:
Ana Li: Quick sync — we need to announce a breaking change for partner SDK auth header (x-rw-auth -> Authorization: Bearer). Planning window: 8 weeks.
Michael Chen: Oof. Breaking change on auth header. Any hard constraints from Marketplace or HW partners?
ACME Integrations: ACME here — 8 weeks should be fine but need clear migration guide + SDK patch. We manage a few on-prem installs.
Samir Patel: Key things: (1) list of SDKs to update, (2) partner-facing migration steps, (3) canary/rollback plan, (4) marketplace listing changes.
Eva Gomez: Also product docs, release notes, and partner portal banner. Legal needs heads-up for contract language if this affects compliance.
Ana Li: Agreed. Proposed rollout: week 0 announce + migration guide, week 3 begin SDK releases (minor bump), week 6 canary traffic with opt-in, week 8 enforce header.
Michael Chen: Who owns SDK patches? I can take python and go clients. Samir can do JS/TS and Node. Eva will draft the partner communication + marketplace blurb.
Samir Patel: I'll PR Node SDK today. Note: old header currently accepted for backward compat with a deprecation warning in logs — we should emit a telemetry flag so we can measure remaining usage.
Ana Li: Good: add telemetry key `legacy_auth_in_use=true` when old header seen. devops-bot: Scheduled job created: `telemetry/legacy-auth-daily` every 24h.
devops-bot: Job created: telemetry/legacy-auth-daily -> writes counts to partnership-alerts. (triggered by @devops-bot)
ACME Integrations: For on-prem we need a small migration script. Can you provide a snippet for server-side proxies?
Michael Chen: Paste for proxies: ```bash
# nginx config snippet to translate header
proxy_set_header Authorization $http_x_rw_auth;
```
Michael Chen: We'll include this in the migration guide and SDK changelogs.
Samir Patel: Also add an opt-in flag in SDKs: `allow_legacy_auth: true` default true until enforcement date; warn on use. We'll release minor version with deprecation log.
Ana Li: Action items: - Michael: python/go SDK PRs + example proxy snippet (due in 3 days) - Samir: node/ts SDK PRs + allow_legacy flag (due in 3 days) - Eva: partner comms + marketplace update draft (due in 5 days) - Infra: add telemetry and a canary pool (devops-bot scheduled job created)
Eva Gomez: Draft partner comms outline: quick summary, why (security + standardization), migration steps (proxy + SDK), timeline, rollback contact. Will post draft to partner portal & slack channel for review.
ACME Integrations: We'll test the proxy snippet in our staging cluster and confirm by EOD Friday. Please include example cURL and code samples.
Samir Patel: cURL example to show header change: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Ana Li: We should also add a compatibility page that lists partner-specific notes (on-prem difference, marketplace connectors). Add a section for hardware partners that run older agents.
Michael Chen: One more risk: some partners use middleware that only sets custom headers. We'll need to include troubleshooting matrix (common proxies, load balancers).
Ana Li: Good call. Include troubleshooting checklist and contact path for expedited support.
Eva Gomez: I'll coordinate with sales + solutions engineering for high-touch partners. Adding a ticket template for partner migrations.
Samir Patel: We'll also add a feature flag on the edge to allow short-term extension per-partner if needed. Need infra sign-off.
devops-bot: Canary pool created: partnerships-canary-01 (50 rps). Watch window: 72h after canary start.
Ana Li: OK team — capture notes in the partner runbook, I'll create a follow-up thread with the migration guide link once Eva posts it. Thanks :thumbsup:
ACME Integrations: Thanks — will report back on staging test.
Michael Chen: PRs opened: python-sdk#512, go-sdk#233. Please review.
Samir Patel: Node PR opened: node-sdk#401. Tests passing locally.
Eva Gomez: Draft posted to partner-docs: https://partners.redwood.ai/migration-auth-v2 — feedback welcome.
Ana Li: Closing for now; we'll reconvene after telemetry baseline in one week.
